name: Cooper-Molera Adobe

dates.altered: Enlarged through the 1830s and 40s (the style node); a $6.5 million rehabilitation completed in 2018 and Save America's Treasures-funded restoration of the Cooper and Diaz adobes after 2022 (National Trust).
dates.note: The style node says begun 1827; the National Trust's page says 'originally dating from 1827'. The Library's item title gives the address as 508 Munras Street where the node says Polk and Munras; the node's string is kept because it is the join key.
